```{r}

#irf_list <- list_irfs
compare_irf <- function(irf_list, variable_names, shock = "price") {
  n_irf <- dim(irf_list[[1]])[2]
  names(irf_list)
  if (shock == "price"){
   shock_label = "$P_{elec}$ shock IRF"
  }else if (shock == "gen"){
    shock_label = "$Q_{elec}$ shock IRF"
  }else{
    return("Invalid shock type. Please use 'price' or 'quantity'.")
  }

  #solution <-gen_benchmark
  plot_irf <- function(i=1) {
    #i=3
    #trick I just put 0.5 twice
    #main_IV <- lambda_0[, i, "lower"]
    # Combine all IRFs into one data frame
    #irf_list[[4]][1:20, i, 1]
    time_horizon <- c(1:20)
    
    df_all <- lapply(seq_along(irf_list), function(j) {
        data.frame(
          time = time_horizon,
          value = irf_list[[j]][1:20, i, 2],
          model = names(irf_list)[j]
        )
      }) %>% bind_rows() %>%
        mutate(
          period = if_else(str_detect(model, "Pre"), "Pre", "Full"),
          country = str_remove(model, " Pre")
        )
    
    ggplot(df_all, aes(x = time, y = value, color = country, linetype = period)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      labs(
        title = TeX(variable_names[i]),
        x = "Time",
        y = "Unit Points"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ESP" ="blue" ,   "FR"="red"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Pre" = "dashed" ,     "Full"= "solid"),
    name = "Period",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
      guides(color = "none", linetype = "none")+
      theme_minimal()
  
  }

  # Generate plots
  plots_list <- lapply(1:n_irf, plot_irf)
  grid_plots <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(plots_list, nrow = 2))
  
  legend_plot <- plot_grid(grid_plots, custom_legend , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))
  return(legend_plot)
  
}
#plot_irf(i=1)
```

```{r}
# Exemple simulé si tu n’as pas défini `simul_data`
set.seed(123)
simul_data <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(100),
  y = rnorm(100),
  colored = rep(names(list_irfs_compare), each = 50),
  Period = rep(c("Pre-crisis", "With-crisis"), 50)
)

# Définir le mapping manuel pour les types de traits
#linetype <- c("Cholesky" = "dashed", "IV" = "solid")

# Plot avec légende uniquement
# Plot avec légende uniquement
plot_legend <- ggplot(data = simul_data, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y, color = colored, linetype = Period))+#, bins = 30, alpha = 0.6) +
  #geom_line(aes(y = y , linetype = Period)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ESP" ="blue" ,   "FR"="red" #,      
               ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Pre-crisis" = "dashed" ,     "With-crisis"= "solid"),
    name = "Period",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
```
